page.overview:
What is Fourth East High School?

This high school is large and sprawling, located in a heavily populated area of Tokyo. At least five stories tall, it provides a wide view of the city from the rooftop, allowing a person to see the decrepit cityscape of apartments, buildings, and factories. Its hallways are comparable to that of any other school, seeming to mostly be polished and well-built.

The school offers Chainsaw Man buns, which Asa despises.

The school also has a Devil Hunter Club.
